EN: WE HAVE NO IDEA! THIS LINE OF QUESTIONING ISN'T IMPORTANT TO US RIGHT NOW! WHY ARE YOU ASKING THESE TANGENTIAL QUESTIONS? STOP IT!

Speaker: Doctor Klein
Topic_Name: What makes you so sure Mobius has my brain?
EN: WE NEED THESE TECHNOLOGIES. YOU NEED TO GET THEM. YOU MUST GET THEM.

Speaker: Doctor Klein
Topic_Name: I can say "no," and I'll do it again. I'm leaving.
EN: LEAVING? BUT YOU CAN'T. I DON'T MEAN THAT AS A THREAT.

Speaker: Doctor Dala
EN: {Hesitating, embarrassed}You... are equipped to retrieve the technologies with your primitive form. We are not.

Speaker: Doctor O
EN: *It's kind of embarrassing. You have hands. And... uh, a heartbeat, sort of. And eyes. Mostly the hands. There's door handles, and lockers, and...*

Speaker: Doctor Klein
EN: ENOUGH. WE NEED YOUR HELP. WILL YOU HELP US?

Speaker: Doctor Klein
Topic_Name: I'll help. What do you need me to do?
EN: EXCELLENT. {Beat}THIS IS TURNING OUT MUCH BETTER THAN THE ACTIVATE-THE-RETREAT-PROTOCOLS-AND-COWER-IN-MY-ROOM IDEA I HAD EARLIER.

Speaker: Doctor O
Topic_Name: I'll help. What do you need me to do?
EN: *Agreed. {Tries to interject with his contribution, but he really hasn't contributed anything}O, and I've used my robotical knowledge to um... eh... transmit the... radio map waves to...*

Speaker: Doctor 8
Topic_Name: I'll help. What do you need me to do?

Speaker: Doctor O
Topic_Name: I'll help. What do you need me to do?
EN: *Settle down, 8, I would have gotten it in a second, all right?! {emph}8's transmitted the last known coordinates of the research centers. They, um...*

Speaker: Doctor O
Topic_Name: I'll help. What do you need me to do?
EN: *{Increasingly quieter}They... well, move sometimes. Or get buried. Or blow up.*

Speaker: Doctor 8
Topic_Name: I'll help. What do you need me to do?

Speaker: Doctor Klein
Topic_Name: I'll help. What do you need me to do?
EN: 8 IS CORRECT. ALL WE NEED ARE THE SCHEMATICS. THIS DOES NOT MEAN WE DO NOT WANT THE COLD, HARD TECHNOLOGY, HOWEVER.

Speaker: Doctor Klein
Topic_Name: I'll help. What do you need me to do?
EN: SO DO NOT GIVE INTO YOUR BIOLOGICAL TIRED-LAZINESS AND DECIDE YOU WOULD SWEAT TOO MUCH CARRYING THEM. YOU HAVE A NEW SPINE. USE IT.

Speaker: Doctor Klein
Topic_Name: I'll help. What do you need me to do?
EN: AND EVEN IF YOU DIE IN THE ACT OF RECLAMATION, SIMPLY REACHING THEM WILL AUTO-TRANSMITIFY THE SCHEMATICS TO US. THAT IS STILL GOOD. FOR US.

Speaker: Doctor Klein
Topic_Name: Why me? Can't you do it?
EN: UM. NO.

Speaker: Doctor Klein
Topic_Name: No, I'm not going to help you.
EN: OH.

Speaker: Doctor O
Topic_Name: No, I'm not going to help you.
EN: *Yes, Dr. Klein? What?*

Speaker: Doctor Klein
Topic_Name: No, I'm not going to help you.
EN: NOT YOU, O, YOU IDIOT! I MEANT "OH," IN THE SENSE OF "OH, I WASN'T PREDICTING IT WOULD RESPOND THAT WAY." CAN IT SAY NO?

Speaker: Doctor Klein
Topic_Name: First, you scoop out my brain, now you want me to save you?!
EN: THAT IS CORRECT, YES. {Beat, not sure, calculating}I HOPE YOU'RE NOT DEMONSTRATING RESENTMENT NOW. {Conclusion}IF YOU ARE, WELL, WE CAN'T HAVE THAT.

Speaker: Doctor Klein
Topic_Name: You said something about needing technologies to stop Mobius?
EN: YES. IT IS OUR ONLY CHANCE, A DESPERATE PLAN THAT CAME TO US AFTER MOBIUS' FIRST BROADCAST.

Speaker: Doctor Klein
Topic_Name: You said something about needing technologies to stop Mobius?
EN: MAYBE... JUST MAYBE... IF WE RECLAIM THESE BURIED TECHNOLOGIES, WE CAN PUT AN END TO MOBIUS AND THE HORRORS SPAWNING FROM THE FORBIDDEN ZONE.

Speaker: Doctor O
Topic_Name: < Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >
EN: *{Quiet, trying not to embarrass himself}What? Like... stuff? Things?*

Speaker: Doctor Klein
Topic_Name: < Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >
EN: YES. THINGS.

Speaker: Doctor O
Topic_Name: < Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >
EN: *{Quiet, skeptical}I don't know... might be some old Nuka Cola or Sunset Sarsaparilla bottlecaps lying around. It... It's not "currency" per se...*

Speaker: Doctor O
Topic_Name: < Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >
EN: *Still, might be enough to trick the Sink's trade routines. Mobius put that test line for caps in the code as a debug command, I think.*

Speaker: Doctor Dala
Topic_Name: < Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >
EN: I don't believe that was Mobius' reason. His wild speculation concerning post-holocaust economic systems was quite extensive. And of high decibel.

Speaker: Doctor Klein
Topic_Name: < Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >
EN: ENOUGH! SURRENDER THESE SO-CALLED BOTTLECAPS, NUKA AND SUNSET ALIKE. IN THEIR ROLE AS THINGS, THEY WILL SERVE AS ADEQUATE TEST SUBJECTS.

Speaker: Doctor O
Topic_Name: < Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >
EN: *What are we going to do? There's no way we can breach the Forbidden Zone. There's those robot scorpions everywhere!*

Speaker: Doctor Borous
Topic_Name: < Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >
EN: -The FORBIDDEN ZONE, where no brain has EVER entered! Nor ever RETURNED.-

Speaker: Doctor Dala
Topic_Name: < Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >
EN: {Correcting}Except Dr. Mobius. And the technologies that could save us, they are out of our reach.

Speaker: Doctor Klein
Topic_Name: < Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >
EN: AND DR. MOBIUS MOCKS US. DID YOU SEE HIS CRACKED MONITOR? HE'S CLEARLY LET HIMSELF GO.

Speaker: Doctor 8
Topic_Name: < Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >

Speaker: Doctor O
Topic_Name: < Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >
EN: *What? Ask the Lobotomite for help? 8, I think you need the fluid levels in your logic-assist-pumps checked.*

Speaker: Doctor Dala
Topic_Name: < Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >
EN: If this Lobotomite responded, Dr. Klein, then it is clearly intelligent, perhaps even displays heretofore unknown levels of helpfulness.

Speaker: Doctor Borous
Topic_Name: < Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >
EN: -But what of its brain? We scooped that out! We don't even know where we left it! And for putting it back in... none of us have the knowledge!-

Speaker: Doctor Dala
Topic_Name: < Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >
EN: Yes, but it's still aware and responsive. Look at it... it's regarding us even now, with its big teddy bear eyes.

Speaker: Doctor Dala
Topic_Name: < Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >
EN: If we ask it politely and leave the part about the unnecessary ruthless lobotimizing out, it might be favorably disposed to us.

Speaker: Doctor Dala
Topic_Name: < Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >
EN: I assume full responsibility. I take my duties in the prodding and excision of living, breathing tissue {emph}quite seriously.

Speaker: Doctor O
Topic_Name: < Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >
EN: *{Quiet, grumbling}All right, all right. Here. Cap away. Hope that stupid chip chokes on them.*

Speaker: Doctor O
Topic_Name: < Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >
EN: *{Quiet, grumbling}Fine. It's not going to help. That chip will probably refuse them anyway, as stuck up as it is.*

Speaker: Doctor O
Topic_Name: < Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >
EN: *{Quiet, irritated}Why don't you make the Lobotomite a bottlecap factory, Klein? Or better yet, give it a ton of things to activate the chip?*

Speaker: Doctor Dala
Topic_Name: < Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >
EN: I do not understand, yet I am intrigued by this potential display.

Speaker: Doctor 8
Topic_Name: < Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >

Speaker: Doctor O
Topic_Name: < Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >
EN: *{Quiet}No, 8, you don't need to fill up the emitter again, really. {Beat}Klein means things... for trade. Display for trade.*

Speaker: Doctor O
Topic_Name: < Debug Topic Node - Do Not Translate. >
EN: *All right, let's consolidate. There's got to be some junk around here... magazines, useless, more caps, medicinal supplies... useless... here.*

Speaker: Book Chute Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
Topic_Name: I found a backup copy of your... pencil processor.
EN: Excellent! Now I can turn pencils and clipboards into items more useful to society... like lead, spare parts, and duct tape!

Speaker: Jukebox Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
Topic_Name: I found a soundwave file for you.
EN: Right on, daddy-o! Just plug it in and I'll mix you up a sweet, sweet sound.

Speaker: Jukebox Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
Topic_Name: I found a soundwave file for you.
EN: Right on, baby! Just plug it in and I'll mix you up a sweet, sweet sound.

Speaker: Stealth Suit Mk II
EN: This is the basic stealth test. The robots will be looking for us, but we won't let them find us.

Speaker: Stealth Suit Mk II
EN: This should be easy. As long as I don't screw up again.

Speaker: Stealth Suit Mk II
EN: This is the advanced test. Watch out for laser tripwires. They'll ruin our day.

Speaker: Stealth Suit Mk II
EN: I'm not supposed to give hints, but maybe you can disable the tripwires.

Speaker: Stealth Suit Mk II
EN: This is the expert stealth test. If you thought the lasers were bad, wait till you see the proximity mines.

Speaker: Stealth Suit Mk II
EN: Psst. If you hack the mines this will go lots faster.

Speaker: Stealth Suit Mk II
EN: This is the robot compliance test. If you sneak up on a robot, you can disable it. It's so easy even I can't mess up.

Speaker: Stealth Suit Mk II
EN: I don't think I can learn anything else here... but if you want to go again, that's fine.

Speaker: Stealth Suit Mk II
EN: Too bad. We hit a tripwire. That one was totally my fault, though. We can start again at the terminal. Sorry...

Speaker: Stealth Suit Mk II
EN: Maybe there's a way around the tripwires.

Speaker: Stealth Suit Mk II
EN: Too bad. We triggered a mine. If you go back to the terminal to restart the test, I'll do better next time.

Speaker: Stealth Suit Mk II
EN: Maybe we can disable the mines quickly, or find another way past. I'm sure you know best.

Speaker: Stealth Suit Mk II
EN: Too bad. We were spotted by robots. If you go back to the terminal to restart the test, I won't mess up again.

Speaker: Stealth Suit Mk II
EN: Stealth Boys are a robot's big weakness.

Speaker: Jukebox Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
Topic_Name: I want to recalibrate the Sonic Emitter.
EN: Right on, daddy. Let's spin some grooves.

Speaker: Jukebox Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
Topic_Name: I want to recalibrate the Sonic Emitter.
EN: Right on, baby. Let's spin some grooves.

Speaker: Muggy
Topic_Name: Have you made any electronic components?
EN: Yup, here you go.

Speaker: Muggy
Topic_Name: Have you made any electronic components?
EN: Sorry, no more today. Try me again tomorrow.

Speaker: Muggy
Topic_Name: I found a backup file for your corroded module.
EN: Great! Let's fire that up so I can start making electronic components again.

Speaker: Stealth Suit Mk II
EN: Mean robot bugs! Mean robot bugs!

Speaker: Muggy
Topic_Name: I found that upgrade disk you were looking for.
EN: Ho-ho, thank God! Finally, something resembling a useful purpose!

Speaker: Auto-Doc Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
Topic_Name: I found you some upgrade disks.
EN: Well, that'll do just fine.

Speaker: Doctor Klein
Topic_Name: Can you tell me more about these pylons?
EN: ASK BOROUS. I BELIEVE HE KNOWS MORE ABOUT THE FENCE THAN ANY BRAIN. EXCEPT MAYBE MOBIUS.

Speaker: Doctor Klein
Topic_Name: Can you tell me more about these pylons?
EN: MOBIUS WAS INVOLVED IN THEIR CONSTRUCTION, IF I RECALL. BUT HE'S SUCH A HACK, HE PROBABLY WAS READING OFF OF BOROUS' NOTES AND SCHEMATICS.

Speaker: Doctor Klein
EN: THE RADAR FENCE THAT SURROUNDS THE BIG MT CRATER WILL PREVENT - ER, PROTECT YOU FROM STRAYING BEYOND THE FACILITY.

Speaker: Doctor Borous
EN: -The mighty radar fence protects us ALL! Get too close to the blinking posts, and the proximity warning shall be your... WARNING you are too close!-

Speaker: Doctor O
EN: *If you get near it, your vision will blur as the electrodes in your head shut off one by one, click click click.*

Speaker: Doctor Dala
EN: {Soothing}Possible memory loss will occur along with long-term nerve degradation. It is tied to not having a brain attached to your nervous system.

Speaker: Doctor Dala
EN: But the nerve degradation is nothing to worry about - such degradation would take {emph}many lifespans to become evident. {Placating, as if "And really,"}And all biology dies.

Speaker: Doctor Dala
EN: Such tiny inconveniences are less than the greater convenience - and conveyance.

Speaker: Doctor Dala
ActorNotes: [Tries to interject a sense of wonder, as if explaining to a child]
EN: {Tries to interject a sense of wonder, as if explaining to a child}You see, if rendered unconscious by the pylons, you will be returned to the Sink, seemingly instantaneously by your deadened perceptions.

Speaker: Doctor Klein
Topic_Name: Then can you help me get this done as quickly as possible? Sounds like a lot of walking.
EN: AH, THAT IS CORRECT. YOU MUST {Emph}WALK UPON YOUR MANY-PENISED FEET. {Emph, condescending}MUCH SLOWER THAN OUR ADVANCED HOVERING ROBOTICAL FRAMES.

Speaker: Doctor Dala
Topic_Name: Then can you help me get this done as quickly as possible? Sounds like a lot of walking.
EN: The little teddy bear could always run right into the pylon perimeter on its thick, turgid feet, returning it to us quickly and erectly - {corrects self}directly.

Speaker: Doctor Klein
Topic_Name: Doesn't sound like my style. Maybe I'll do a little exploring.
EN: YOU WOULD NOT DARE. PERHAPS I CAN CHANGE YOUR MIND... USING THE GREATEST OF OUR SCIENCES. THE FENCE.

Speaker: Doctor Klein
Topic_Name: What if I take my time, explore the crater?
EN: {Slight anger}WHAT ILLOGIC IS THIS?! KEEP YOUR FILTHY PENIS-TIPPED FEET OUT OF OUR LABS AND SECRETS!

Speaker: Doctor Borous
Topic_Name: What if I take my time, explore the crater?
EN: -There are things here no Lobotomite was MEANT to see, things that would ASTOUND! And possibly terrify. TERRIFY!-

Speaker: Doctor O
Topic_Name: What if I take my time, explore the crater?
EN: *{We don't come over to your house and "f" your wife}Yeah, we don't come into your lab and decant {emph}your solutions.*

Speaker: Doctor Dala
Topic_Name: What if I take my time, explore the crater?
EN: Only the magnificence of {emph}our monitors allow for true comprehension of the wonders of Big MT. Shield your jellied eyes lest they burn from your skull.

Speaker: Doctor Klein
Topic_Name: The faster I can get through this, the better.
EN: OUR INTENTIONS EXACTLY. THE IMPORTANT THING IS YOU RUSH QUICKLY THROUGH THIS TASK SO AS NOT TO WASTE {Emph}OUR TIME.

Speaker: Doctor Klein
Topic_Name: The faster I can get through this, the better.
EN: DO {Emph}NOT GET CURIOUS OR YOU WILL END UP LIKE THE CAT OF SCHRÖDINGER.

Speaker: Doctor Dala
Topic_Name: The faster I can get through this, the better.
EN: We feared you would be tempted to explore Big MT Crater and examine the {emph}many amazing non-mandatory research labs that lie off your designated path.

Speaker: Doctor Dala
Topic_Name: The faster I can get through this, the better.
EN: {Chiding}The many such optional explorations are discouraged. Work hurriedly, as if you have blinders on, and leave curiosities and items of interest alone.

Speaker: Doctor Borous
Topic_Name: The faster I can get through this, the better.
EN: -So many sciences and developments! Pass them by! Let impatience and the desire to simply finish, to end it all, quickly and carelessly guide you!-

Speaker: Doctor 8
Topic_Name: The faster I can get through this, the better.

Speaker: Doctor O
Topic_Name: The faster I can get through this, the better.
EN: *Right you are, 8. In our test results, we'll make a note about how quickly you ran our maz... er, exper... Nobel... challenge.*

Speaker: Doctor Dala
Topic_Name: The faster I can get through this, the better.
EN: {Soothing}After all, there will be plenty of time afterward to partake of the experiments once {emph}our bidding is done.

Speaker: Doctor Klein
Topic_Name: This whole place sounds dangerous. These devices sound dangerous.
EN: NONSENSE. THIS PLACE IS NO MORE DANGEROUS THAN A NUCLEAR DETONATION SITE, OUR TECHNOLOGIES NO MORE LETHAL THAN AN OVERCHARGED TESLA CANNON.

Speaker: Sink Auto-Doc
EN: <Cheering>

Speaker: Christine
EN: {Quiet, Ulysses has just entered}...didn't think you'd make it back.

Speaker: Christine
ActorNotes: [Dismissive, matter-of-fact] AUDIO: In this log, Christine is greeting Ulysses when he's come back from a difficult journey. She's still recovering on her bunk.
EN: {Dismissive, matter-of-fact}Almost didn't. Got my answers. {Rueful}Your Elijah, he met the Gods in this place, did a good job of making them question the way of things.

Speaker: Christine
EN: {Hunting instinct}Do you know where he went?

Speaker: Christine
EN: He's gone to the Sierra Madre. That's a special kind of hell. He won't come back. Someone smarter, tougher's going to kill him. If the Madre doesn't.

Speaker: Christine
EN: {Determined, angry, hates this guy}I have to go after him.

Speaker: Christine
EN: Not going to talk you out of it. Know what it means to track someone you share history with. Got a meeting of my own.

Speaker: Christine
EN: {Quiet}That Courier?

Speaker: Christine
EN: {Nods}Get her to come to me. {Beat, slow}Got a message for her, like the message she had for me.

Speaker: Christine
EN: {Cold, staring into future, slight bitterness}Make them walk the road west, straight and true, sink their feet in Old World ash. Let storms tear at them. See the Divide. See what happened.

Speaker: Christine
EN: {Divide = Dangerous, desolate area, quiet}The Divide? There's nothing there.

Speaker: Christine
EN: {Slight smile}Nothing there? Like the Big Empty? The Sierra Madre? No, the Old World sleeps there, sure as the flag I carry. The Courier knows the way.

Speaker: Christine
EN: {Closing note, foreshadowing final conflict}And at the Divide, her and I - there, we'll have an ending to things.

Speaker: Christine
EN: {DUPE}{Quiet, Ulysses has just entered}...didn't think you'd make it back.

Speaker: Christine
ActorNotes: [DUPE] "Almost didn't." --> As in, "almost didn't make it back." Dismissive.
EN: {DUPE}{Dismissive, matter-of-fact}Almost didn't. Got my answers. {Rueful}Your Elijah, he met the Gods in this place, did a good job of making them question the way of things.

Speaker: Christine
EN: {DUPE}{Quiet}That Courier?

Speaker: Christine
EN: {Nods}Get him to come to me. {Beat}Got a message for him, like the message he had for me.

Speaker: Christine

Speaker: Christine
EN: {Closing note, foreshadowing final conflict}And at the Divide, he and I - there, we'll have an ending to things.

Speaker: Christine
ActorNotes: [Slight frustration, trying to make a point]
EN: {Slight frustration, trying to make a point}...don't want to argue philosophy with you. Brotherhood are {emph}preservationists. Tech in the wrong hands, it's dangerous. Mojave's proof.

Speaker: Christine
ActorNotes: [Shrugs] AUDIO: In this log, Christine is debating with Ulysses, her "doctor." She's still recovering on her bunk - a little tired, but still strong.
EN: {Shrugs}No denying that. Proof's here in this crater, all around us. {Beat, slightly appraising}Your tribe, the Brotherhood - haven't met many of you. Wanted to.

Speaker: Christine
EN: {More reflective}Thought you might be the last chance for the Mojave... the West. The East. But you're all the same mind, obsessed.

Speaker: Christine
EN: {emph, correcting}Elijah is obsessed. He's mad. It's why they ordered his execution.

Speaker: Christine
EN: {"You..."}Two are more alike than you know, too wrapped in the wrong bits of history to see ahead. {Shrugs}Not judging. I know how it is.

Speaker: Christine
EN: {Quieter, reflective}People are like couriers, you and him. Sometimes don't even know the message they bring.

Speaker: Christine
EN: {Turns attention back to her}You all had a {emph}new flag. Thought maybe new ideas along with it. {Beat, quieter}What you believe isn't any better than the Bear or Bull. No future in either.

Speaker: Christine
EN: {Defiance}So says the man with the Old World flag on his back. America, the Commonwealth... burned away.

Speaker: Christine
EN: {Slight anger, low}America {emph}sleeps. And until it's dead, I carry it. Just like I carried you. More than hope. Belief.

Speaker: Christine
EN: There's voices here in the Big Empty, I want to talk to them. Not like your Elijah did. {End on a downnote, like a movie trailer going away}Got questions. Want to hear history give its answer.

Speaker: Christine
ActorNotes: [Quiet, she's in a cell - she's been tortured, but recovering]
EN: {Quiet, she's in a cell - she's been tortured, but recovering}This is Christine Royce. Knight of the Brotherhood of Steel... the Circle.

Speaker: Christine
ActorNotes: AUDIO: In this log, Christine has just been operated on. She's not horribly weak, but definitely tired and worn out - she's committed to die.
EN: Not going to make it through this, hope someone finds this message, gets it to the Brotherhood in the West.

Speaker: Christine
EN: Tracked a rogue Brotherhood Elder, Elijah, here, to the Big Empty. {Breath}Place is more than it seems, there's a crater hidden deep inside.

Speaker: Christine
EN: Junkyard of Pre-War labs scattered across the crater's surface, all still running... {to herself, mutters}like this one.

Speaker: Christine
EN: Elijah's dissecting these centers, one by one... tracked him to an old Chinese-American internment camp. Survivors, Ghouls, have bomb collars.

Speaker: Christine
EN: Robots moved in when I tried to intercept him... Elijah sent the camp Ghouls against us both, like walking bombs.

Speaker: Christine
EN: Got hit by the explosions, woke up here. {To herself}Guess the medical robots were programmed to bring wounded victims from the camp to this center.

Speaker: Christine
EN: Some kind of Auto-Doc prototype lab... manned by corpses trapped inside suits that keep them moving, no idea why.

Speaker: Christine
EN: Not sure how long I'm going to last... cut open my head like a lot of the humans I've seen here, feel strange, can talk, but can't hack the term...{"terminal," trails off}

Speaker: Christine
ActorNotes: [AUDIO: Need a distant explosion as Ulysses breaks in to save Christine.]
EN: {AUDIO: Need a distant explosion as Ulysses breaks in to save Christine.}

Speaker: Christine
EN: {AUDIO}...wait, an explosion outside. Someone's here... someone's... {crackles, fades}

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: I was curious about some things.
EN: Oh, curiosity. I experience that less now that I know everything. Or maybe it was when I found out some unpleasant answers? Mmm-hmm.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: I was curious about some things.
EN: I find things curious as well. Go on.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
ActorNotes: [Player keeps asking questions, likes this, like talking to a small child]
Topic_Name: I was curious about some things.
EN: {Player keeps asking questions, likes this, like talking to a small child}Yes, yes, this is getting interesting. You are just filled with these little slices of curiosity, aren't you?

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: Now, that seems to be rather hormonal of you. Flight or fight response, you know, hard to cut that out completely.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: Your brain is here, safe with me. {Smiles}We chat over Mentats.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: {Frowns}I'm not sure except that I'm sure there's a {emph}very good raisin for it. I have very good raisins for almost everything I do.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: Even if I forget them occasionally. Although I feel this one is especially important. Ha! Oh well.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: Why did you steal my brain?
EN: Oh, a variety of {"reasons"}raisins... you're something of a homily. Er, anomaly? You're really {"quite"}quiet special, and not in the cranially-challenged way.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: Why did you steal my brain?
EN: You see, you are the most successful brain extraction experiment ever performed here at Big MT. A victim of your own success, as it were.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: Why did you steal my brain?
EN: If you were to go back with what {emph}your brain knows about the procedure, well...

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: Why did you steal my brain?
EN: ...your brain could be popped back in and you could walk right out of here. Can't have brains moving around of their own volition.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: Do you? You seem fine without it.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: And does it even want to go back with you? Maybe you should ask it. It's quite independent, has all manner of opinions.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: Tell you what - I'll leave it up to your brain. If it wants to go, then fine. If not... well, you should respect its wishes.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: You aren't exactly what I was expecting.
EN: {Curious}Really. That implies pre-conceived notions - theories and a hypothesis about this meeting? Please extrapolate. What was I... supposed to be like?

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: You aren't exactly what I was expecting.
EN: After all, it might be worth a cognitive re-alignment if your theoretical Mobius is better than I.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: Whichever way you want to be killed is fine with me.
EN: How gracious of you. A mannerly killing.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: I'll trash them like I did your giant piece of junk downstairs.
EN: Oh now you've done it. I feel a twinge of regret over that little mistake I left on.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: I'll trash them like I did your giant piece of junk downstairs.
EN: {Fight, low sinister}Minions - destroy this intruder! {Changes tone, curious}Mmm. Or perhaps make it more dramatic?

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: I'll trash them like I did your giant piece of junk downstairs.

EN: It is the pacification field emitters that are broadcasting into the emptiness of your skull. Without a brain, your aggression is suppressed in here.

Speaker: Doctor Dala
Topic_Name: But how am I still talking and walking around?
EN: That is a good question. My theory is that the tesla coils in your brainpan are still connected to your brain somehow.

Speaker: Doctor Dala
Topic_Name: But how am I still talking and walking around?
EN: It really could be anywhere. Brains are a lot smarter than most researchers give them credit for.

Speaker: Doctor Dala
Topic_Name: But how am I still talking and walking around?
EN: We still have your spine and heart. If you were to somehow find your brain wherever it schlorped off to, you could humanically reduce yourself again.

Speaker: Doctor Dala
Topic_Name: Why did you say "three minus one" subjects before?
EN: Because three minus one is two. Two spoke to us, one after the other, one mean, one curious, but there was a third we didn't speak to.

Speaker: Doctor Dala
Topic_Name: Why did you say "three minus one" subjects before?
EN: The last one is the minus one. It got traumatized, then taken to one of our medical centers for de-traumatization. A rather unsettling procedure.

Speaker: Doctor Dala
Topic_Name: Is there any way to remove the pacification field in here?
EN: {Genuinely curious}Why would you want such a thing? You might surrender to your hormones and commit primal aggression on me... on us... again and again.

Speaker: Doctor Dala
Topic_Name: Is there any way to remove the pacification field in here?
EN: Then I would have to return the favor, activating my vivisectors and gently lobotomizing you from behind. {Lying}Not something I would relish doing.

Speaker: Doctor Dala
Topic_Name: Is there any way to remove the pacification field in here?
EN: No, the only way to circumvent the field is to have a brain. And we extracted that like we do all Lobotomites here.

Speaker: Brain Tank
EN: {Narration}{Good or Neutral Karma}With the Courier at the helm, Science became a beacon for the future.

Speaker: Brain Tank
EN: {Narration}There was Old World Blues, and New World Hope. {Beat}And hope ruled the day at Big {Mountain}MT.

Speaker: Brain Tank
EN: {Narration}{Bad Karma}{Sad}With the Courier at the helm, it was all this and more.

Speaker: Brain Tank
EN: {Narration}Old World Blues, New World Misery - the two became one in the Courier's shadow.

Speaker: Doctor Dala
EN: {Narration}It can be easy to see Science as evil, technology unchecked as the source of all ills, all misfortunes.

Speaker: Doctor O
EN: {Narration}{Bad Karma}It became a reality, a withering form of nostalgia for times long past.

Speaker: Doctor Klein
EN: {Narration}{Good or Neutral Karma}Where once it was viewed as a form of sadness, nostalgia, it became an expression describing the {emph}potential for the future.

Speaker: Doctor Klein
EN: {Narration}{Bad Karma}In the time following the Second Battle of Hoover Dam, "Old World Blues" became more than a catch phrase.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: {Narration}{Good or Neutral Karma}In the times following the Second Battle of Hoover Dam, however, Old World Blues took on a new meaning.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: {Narration}{Bad Karma}The Big Empty lived up to its name, a hollow crater of failures of a past era, a last, sad statement of the Old World.

Speaker: Doctor O
EN: {Narration}Science is a long, steady progression into the {emph}future. What may seem a sudden event often isn't felt for years, even centuries, to come.

Speaker: Doctor Dala
EN: {Narration}They stare into the what-was, eyes like pilot lights, guttering and spent, as the realities of their world continue on around them.

Speaker: Doctor Klein
EN: {Narration}It refers to those so obsessed with the past they can't see the present, much less the future, for what it {emph}is.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: {Narration}There is an expression in the Wasteland: "Old World Blues."

Speaker: Brain Tank
EN: {Narration}{Bad Karma}And so it burbled and bubbled inside its tank, smug that it still could dream {emph}its future without {Emph, disdain}glands getting in the way.

Speaker: Brain Tank
EN: {Narration}In time, however, it became so self-obsessed it wondered if perhaps nothing existed except itself.

Speaker: Brain Tank
EN: {Narration}It decided to test this by turning the weapons of the Big Empty against each other and seeing what happened.

Speaker: Brain Tank
EN: {Narration}{Quiet}The answer is lost to history, {beat, wary}as is much of the Mojave.

Speaker: Brain Tank
EN: {Narration}{Good or Neutral Karma}Even at the end when it started to fail, however, the brain resisted going into a floating chassis like the Think Tank.

Speaker: Brain Tank
EN: {Narration}It never said why. Perhaps it was out of respect for the Courier's body.

Speaker: Brain Tank
EN: {Narration}{Quiet, respectful}All things must come to an end, and to hang on to the past is something that's not to be undertaken lightly.

Speaker: Brain Tank
EN: {Narration}{PC took brain back}The Courier, organs intact, continued onwards, a little less heavy of step, but with all the organs in the right places. As they should be.

Speaker: Brain Tank
EN: {Narration}{Knowingly}After all, brains can develop a life of their own when left to their own thoughts, and the Courier's brain was more clever than most.

Speaker: Brain Tank
EN: {Narration}{PC left brain in tank}The Courier left the brain at the Big Empty. A strange thing to say, but it was the truth. Brains are less important than they may seem.

Speaker: Brain Tank
EN: {Narration}When the Courier's body finally passed, the brain was saddened. It kept on, remembering the vessel that had once contained it.

Speaker: Mister Gutsy Mk1
EN: {Narration}{Done with barking}The two of them constructed a litter of cyberpups, a small army of Boston terrifiers that gnawed and devoured anything in their path.

Speaker: Mister Gutsy Mk1
EN: {Narration}{Rex not dead, not available}{Done with barking}There, she ran across Rex at the Kings School of Impersonation. His brain was failing. That was all right, he was still smarter than the Think Tank.

Speaker: Mister Gutsy Mk1
EN: {Narration}{Rex not dead, is available}{Done with barking}There, she ran across Rex, who had been following the Courier, just as she had. They barked for a while, and realized they had a lot in common.

Speaker: Roxie
EN: {Narration}{Rex dead}{Done with barking}There, she ran across the corpse of Rex. She dragged him back to the Big Empty and had him rebuilt for company.

Speaker: Mister Gutsy Mk1
EN: {Narration}{Done with barking}The cybernetic canine, gender: female, designation: ROXIE sat in her guard post in X-8.

Speaker: Mister Gutsy Mk1
EN: {Narration}That is, until her "I'm in heat" programming circumvented her "stay" routine and she loped into the Mojave.

Speaker: Auto-Doc Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}{Y-17 was discovered}In time, the Auto-Doc found a way to deactivate the Y-17 Trauma Harnesses, releasing the corpses they had held prisoner for almost 200 years.

Speaker: Auto-Doc Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}Auto-Doc, always gentle and methodical, kept sewing up the Courier in all the right places when the skin split open from repeated wear and tear.

Speaker: Auto-Doc Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}The Auto-Doc was just glad to have purpose again.

Speaker: Auto-Doc Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}It heard its simpler brothers and sisters who got shipped to the Sierra Madre were bored out of their skulls in that toxic, dead city.

Speaker: Jukebox Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}{Both light switches found}It was rumored by the other personalities that he had a brief fling with the light switches.

Speaker: Jukebox Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}Although he forgot their names once too often and was soon left in the dark as punishment.

Speaker: Jukebox Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}{< 3 Sound effects gained}Blind Diode Jefferson eventually discovered a new sound... silence. It only made him more filled with the blues than before.

Speaker: Jukebox Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}{3+ Sound effects gained}Blind Diode Jefferson, with sounds the Courier brought him, created a symphonic counter-frequency that saved Big {Mountain}MT from sonic invasion in 2910.

Speaker: Jukebox Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}If you didn't hear about it - good.

Speaker: Muggy
EN: {Narration}{Higgs Village not discovered}Muggy continued to collect coffee cups until his wheel got a flat just out of reach of a dirty coffee cup, and his tiny robotic brain exploded.

Speaker: Muggy
EN: {Narration}{Higgs Village was discovered}Muggy did his best to collect coffee cups, although in his quest, he accidentally trapped himself in Higgs' Village.

Speaker: Muggy
EN: {Narration}It might have been the end for poor Muggy.

Speaker: Muggy
EN: {Narration}Except... he found it peaceful there, tidying up the kitchens of the Think Tank Professors back when they had been flesh and bone.

Speaker: Muggy
EN: {Narration}{To himself}Well, except for Dr. O, who was an asshole for having created Muggy in the first place.

Speaker: Muggy
EN: {Narration}{Proudly defiant}Muggy left O's house deliberately dirty, punishing the dishes and cups that lived there in blind revenge for serving Dr. O.

Speaker: Toaster Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}{Bad Karma}It learned several new murderous techniques from the Courier, and built a Blood Shrine to itself in the Cuckoo's Nest.

Speaker: Toaster Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}The cave floor was soon filled with the horror of a hundred gutted toasters, a silent, grisly, unplugged audience...

Speaker: Toaster Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}...their purpose... to toast bread... unfulfilled.

Speaker: Toaster Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}{Good or Neutral Karma}After one of its more psychotic episodes, however, the other Sink personalities decided enough was enough, and dumped the Toaster in a bathtub.

Speaker: Toaster Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}Sparking and hissing, the Toaster swore its enemies would rue the day when they had bread - and no way to toast it.

Speaker: Toaster Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}The Toaster continued its psychotic spree, reducing all appliances in range to scrap electronics and spare parts.

Speaker: Sink Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}{Innovative Toxins Plant discovered}Once it learned of the Innovative Toxins Plant, however, it gained new purpose.

Speaker: Sink Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}It sought to develop anti-toxins to flush into its drains and counteract the poisons bleeding into the soil.

Speaker: Sink Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}{Magnetohydraulics Plant discovered}Eventually, it gained access to the {Mag-neat-o-Hydraulics}Magnetohydraulics Plant and nearly flooded all the Big Empty in an attempt to scrub the crater clean.

Speaker: Sink Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}The Sink continued to ruthlessly scrub any particulate matter that came near it.

Speaker: Light Switch 01 Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}{Lightwave Dynamics Lab discovered}One of them eventually transferred to the Lightwave Dynamics Plant - and began a long, unrequited affair with one of the holograms.

Speaker: Light Switch 02 Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}This persisted until the day someone dropped a flashlight in the Sink, and the two of them united in their hatred of the "showboat."

Speaker: Sink CIU
EN: {Narration}{Found both light switches}The light switches continued to bicker and flicker.

Speaker: Book Chute Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}The Book Chute continued to devour all seditious materials until it nearly choked on a paper clip.

Speaker: Book Chute Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}It adamantly maintained it was a {emph}Chinese paper clip, and the whole thing had been an elaborately orchestrated assassination attempt.

Speaker: Book Chute Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}Whatever the reason, it slowed down for a while, carefully appraising each document and clipboard that came to it.

Speaker: Bio Research Station Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}{X-22 not discovered}The Biological Research Station, obsessed with seeding everything in sight, ran out of fertile plots and blew a circuit trying to seed itself.

Speaker: Bio Research Station Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}{X-22 was discovered}The Biological Research Station, obsessed with seeding everything in sight, requested a transfer to the X-22 Botanical Garden...

Speaker: Bio Research Station Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}...so that it might, in its own words, "sensually fertilize the garden's smooooth contours."

Speaker: Bio Research Station Voice (NOT USED IN GAME)
EN: {Narration}The Garden sent back a polite refusal, saying it had prior commitments with a Vault it had helped infect before the war.

Speaker: Sink CIU
EN: {Narration}{1 module installed}The Sink was strangely silent, which it had never been in previous years. The lack of personality modules made the base lifeless and sterile.

Speaker: Sink CIU
EN: {Narration}{2-4 modules installed}The Sink atop the Dome gained a frontier town feel with the few modules installed.

Speaker: Sink CIU
EN: {Narration}They shouted at each other across the HQ occasionally, either threatening each other, or announcing a discovery. It kept things... lively.

Speaker: Sink CIU
EN: {Narration}Secretly, the Sink Central Intelligence Unit was relieved that not all of the personality chips had been found. What was there, was enough.

Speaker: Sink CIU
EN: {Narration}{5+ modules installed}The Sink atop the Dome bustled with the voices of a small town, constantly chirping, arguing, and snarling at each other.

Speaker: Sink CIU
EN: {Narration}Still, this all happened productively in the interests of its new owner.

Speaker: Sink CIU
EN: {Narration}The Sink Central Intelligence Unit discovered, despite its inversion code, it was comforted by the sense of community the other personalities gave it.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: {Narration}{Good or Neutral Karma player, sad}...a cobweb tracery of symbols that told of a thousand brilliant thoughts, now lost to time.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: {Narration}{Bad Karma}...but these equations were nothing more than thin white traceries of lines, not unlike cobwebs in the corners of a failing mind.

Speaker: Sink CIU
EN: {Narration}{<10 Locations explored}Although, truth be told, the Courier had barely explored the Crater in an attempt to rush through and be done with the whole thing...

Speaker: Sink CIU
EN: {Narration}Perhaps that was for the best, however... curiosity, while sometimes rewarded for its efforts, often proves to be equally dangerous.

Speaker: Sink CIU
EN: {Narration}{10-25 Locations explored}The Courier had scoured much of the Big Empty, although secrets still remained in the crater's depths.

Speaker: Sink CIU
EN: {DUPE}{Narration}Perhaps that was for the best, however... curiosity, while sometimes rewarded for its efforts, often proves to be equally dangerous.

Speaker: Sink CIU
EN: {Narration}{>25 Locations explored}The Sink Central Intelligence Unit was impressed by the amount of exploration the Courier had undertaken.

Speaker: Sink CIU
EN: {Narration}Facilities believed lost, destroyed, or ones that had simply gotten up and walked to new locations had been re-discovered by its intrepid new master.

Speaker: Sink CIU
EN: {Narration}Internally, the artificial personality debated as to whether it preferred the old management to the new...

Speaker: Sink CIU
EN: {Narration}...and concluded that the Courier's thorough approach to research and investigation was admirable and worthy of its respect.

Speaker: Stealth Suit Mk II
EN: {Quiet amazement}Wow... what {emph}is this place? Are we... outside?

Speaker: Stealth Suit Mk II
EN: Oh, that's too bad. Those robots would normally help defend us and the facility if we're attacked.

Speaker: Stealth Suit Mk II
EN: We were never allowed to blow the robots up before. Cheating gives me such a thrill!

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: If you don't get to the point, I'm going to start shooting.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {DUPE}Yes. Very good. I should have Mentats ingest you instead of the other way around. Mmm. Mentats.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: If you don't get to the point, I'm going to start shooting.
EN: The only "wrinkle" is the one that bullet made going into my brainpan.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: If you don't get to the point, I'm going to start shooting.
EN: [FAILED] {DUPE}I would spell it out for you, but when I start spelling, I lose track of the letters. Little symbols run around everywhere, annoying.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: Was there any other data transmitted in your threat broadcast?
EN: Yes, my overly aggressive chemmed-up broadcast was designed to keep reinforcing the "forget," "fear," "rinse," and "repeat" program.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: Was there any other data transmitted in your threat broadcast?
EN: Oh, and the "get me the things to castrate your only possible escape attempt."

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: Was there any other data transmitted in your threat broadcast?
EN: But I couldn't delete you or your arrival anymore than I could the other visitors. {Shakes head}Only so much Science can do when you started talking to them.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: Was there any other data transmitted in your threat broadcast?
EN: You're really quiet difficult to ignore, you know. It's because you're... well, bah! Rather intriguing, if you'll forgive an old brain for saying so.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: But the Think Tank downloaded the schematics, not the items. They can rebuild them.
EN: Oh. That means my plan is a total failure. That is unfortunate.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: But the Think Tank downloaded the schematics, not the items. They can rebuild them.
EN: Oh, well, at least I tried.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: What is the purpose of the technologies?
EN: The X-2 Antenna can be used to focus your alpha wave frequency thought patterns. The Sneaky Suit? Why, it houses a cardiac regulator.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: What is the purpose of the technologies?
EN: And the sonic soundwave projecto-emitter was never intended as a weapon. It was a medicinal vertebrae-pulse-de-sensitizer.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: What is the purpose of the technologies?
EN: In short: Brains, a heart, and courage... spine. {Thinking, talking about Wizard of Oz}I think there was a story once where a band of murderous thugs sought these things.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: What is the purpose of the technologies?
EN: {Rueful}They had them all the time in the story. Didn't stop them from murdering to get them, and it won't stop the Think Tank, either.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: I don't understand why they wanted me to gather the technologies.
EN: [SUCCEEDED] I consider "coincidence" to be profanity, along with the words, "astrology," "herbal tea," and "luck." So watch it, Potty Mouth.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: I don't understand why they wanted me to gather the technologies.
EN: Klein said they had the idea to get the three technologies after your broadcast. Coincidence?

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: I don't understand why they wanted me to gather the technologies.
EN: [FAILED] Oh, I don't think they understood, either.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: The first one, the ruthless one who smashed up our toy trains, asked for weapons, power. Items he could use to destroy a nation with force.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: {Quiet, a little worried}The other... the other asked a different question, and with it, got the true answer. About what makes nations... and what breaks them.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: He spoke to the Think Tank, to Klein. Showed them the flag of the Old World... and it made them remember. All of it. All that had happened.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: They shared things with him that they shouldn't. He now carries those ideas, that knowledge elsewhere.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: Do you know anything about the other visitors?
EN: Oh, not much, except they contaminated Big MT and installed new ideas in the Think Tank.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: Do you know anything about the other visitors?
EN: One caused a great deal of infrastructure damage with his brain and smartyness. Ruthless, that one. Played a little rough with the trains.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: Do you know anything about the other visitors?
EN: {Thinking}But the last one was the most dangerous. Him... eh... slipping away... that was almost as bad as the Think Tank escaping.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: So you set your threats on a loop to keep them occupied?
EN: Yes. I certainly wouldn't loop it on purpose purpose purpose. I am far too sophisticated to make such a childish error error error.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: What, some kind of medical condition?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {DUPE}Yes. Very good. I should have Mentats ingest you instead of the other way around. Mmm. Mentats.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: What, some kind of medical condition?
EN: A cranial injury. From the attack outside Goodsprings.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: What, some kind of medical condition?
EN: [FAILED] {DUPE}I would spell it out for you, but when I start spelling, I lose track of the letters. Little symbols run around everywhere, annoying.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: Huh? What are you talking about?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] Yes. Very good. I should have Mentats ingest you instead of the other way around. Mmm. Mentats.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: Huh? What are you talking about?
EN: The bullet that went into my brain? Doc Mitchell tried to patch me up, but...

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: Huh? What are you talking about?
EN: [FAILED] I would spell it out for you, but when I start spelling, I lose track of the letters. Little symbols run around everywhere, annoying.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: But there must have been other signs of a larger world.
EN: There have been other visitors to make them doubt their perceptions, but you are the one who dialed back their monitor-micro-magnifiers.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: But there must have been other signs of a larger world.
EN: You were irrefutable proof that there was a world outside. And then there was the whole "brain" fiasco, which forced me to take steps.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: But there must have been other signs of a larger world.
EN: See, your brain had a special kind of... uh... wrinkle, a unique-ity that they had never thought to try in all their countless escape attempts.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: If you lobotomized the Think Tank, why terrorize them?
EN: Well, it's simple. Despite their many failings, they are rather bright. They are the "Think Tank" for a raisin. That, I didn't change.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: If you lobotomized the Think Tank, why terrorize them?
EN: Without something to distract them, make them afraid, they would simply de-deuce what had happened. And when they start deucing it up...

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: If you lobotomized the Think Tank, why terrorize them?
EN: Then you came along, the final variable solved. They saw that their world was larger than they perceived. Bacteria, finally able to see its host.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: "Ouro-bor-ous?" What the hell does that mean?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Genuinely surprised}Really? It is so unlike me to make an error in anything I do.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: "Ouro-bor-ous?" What the hell does that mean?
EN: Minor detail, but a snake devouring its own tail is "Ouro-borus," not "Ouro-borous."

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: "Ouro-bor-ous?" What the hell does that mean?
EN: [FAILED] A snake that sucks its own dingle-thingy, I believe. Borous was always too obsessed with animals and their dingle-thingies.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: That's kind of an asshole thing to do to your friends.
EN: Is it? Hmm... I suppose it is. But really, they started the whole "excrement hole" behavior loop in the first place.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: Dr. O... which is actually not his real name multiplied, since you can't multiply his real name in the first place... {Trying for oo-roh-BOH-rohs}Ouro-bor-ous, Klein...

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: They have all forgotten themselves. And not only themselves, but the world, sense of time, and history. All that is left is what's here.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: I reprogrammed their chronometers, geometers, and cartography programs. This is now their world, here, Big {Mountain}MT.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: It was a merciful lobotomy, really, thinking back. They were my friends, but... {genuine sad moment}sometimes they would take things too far.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: {Quiet, sad}And the world isn't ready for that kind of too-far-thing-taking. That's my professional opinion, anyway, and I am told I was once quiet professional.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: In any event, {emph}you showed up at the Think Tank, and because you had suffered a cranial injury in just the right place...

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: Bullets in the head are usually much more fatal, and yours was a light case of bullet-head-itis.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: But... it was enough for the Auto-Doc in the Sink to change its programming to fix the problem. And the brain extraction technology for once, worked.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: That gave the Think Tank the knowledge its brains shouldn't... couldn't... {should+couldn't}sh'couldn't possess. With that knowledge, the procedure can be reversed.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: If they obtain that procedural data, they can use it to mush and modify their cranial selves into hosts to slip past the Radar Fence, I'm sure of it.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: And once they're off the reservation...

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: My threat broadcast is designed to instill... and install... fear. And along with the emotional download, other data rides the fear carrier wave.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: It prompted them to focus on retrieving those technologies and bring them to "attack" me.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: And coincidentally... pardon my language... all those technologies are needed to put a brain, your brain, back into its skull. Properly.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: So that's why they have all those stupid names?
EN: [SUCCEEDED] O, you figured it out. No pun intended.

Speaker: Player / Courier
Topic_Name: So that's why they have all those stupid names?
EN: Klein... Mobius... O's a circle... 8's an infinity symbol... they're all loops, I get it.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
Topic_Name: So that's why they have all those stupid names?
EN: [FAILED] {Slightly hurt}I don't know if they're stupid, I was trying for accuracy.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: The Radar Fence to keep the Think Tank hemmed in wasn't really enough. They keep testing things, they would have found a way to disarm it.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: {To himself}I suspect I have Plan 9s in place, but I may have coded myself to forget them, just in case... they're probably very dangerous, lethal, or worse.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: So I had to do something else to keep them occupied here. Or as you like to say "trapped." I prefer to have several Plan 9s in case the 7s fail.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: {To himself}I suspect I have Plan Cs in place, but I may have coded myself to forget them, just in case... they're probably very dangerous, lethal, or worse.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: So I had to do something else to keep them occupied here. Or as you like to say "trapped." I prefer to have several plan Bs in case the As fail.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: [SUCCEEDED] {Chiding}Now, "trap" is a rather harsh word. Like "excrement." Not an inappropriate word, but still - rather harsh.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: But... yes, I did... take some liberties with their programming. It's all right, they don't remember.

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
EN: I certainly didn't until you said "trap." And then I said "excrement." And then...

Speaker: Player / Courier
EN: You reprogrammed their names as part of recursion loop? What, to trap their processors?

Speaker: Doctor Mobius
